[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/02/20 (Mon) 01:51.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Adidas Superstar is a classic shoe with a leather upper, rubber outsole, and a shell toe design.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The average weight of the Adidas Superstar is around 11-12 oz (310-340 grams) for a men's size 9.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The break-in period for the Adidas Superstar is typically around 1-2 weeks.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The shell toe cap of the Adidas Superstar might feel stiff initially but becomes more comfortable after breaking in.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Alternatives for daily walking include the Adidas Ultraboost, New Balance Fresh Foam, and Brooks Ghost.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Adidas Superstar provides moderate cushioning and support, which may or may not be sufficient for walking 10,000 steps daily.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] User should consider their foot type and personal preferences when choosing a shoe for daily walking.
